ns2:course.label: Applied Regression Models I
ns2:course.description: Application of simple regression methods to problems in agricultural and consumer economics with emphasis on foundational probability, random variable, and distribution concepts, development of the simple, two-variable regression model; estimation of model parameters; hypothesis testing; and prediction. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: ACE 262 or equivalent; one of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: ACE 262 or equivalent; one of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Agr & Consumer Economics department.
